selected_candidate.name: quarterly_net_profit_scale_rank
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: Among already profitable firms, a higher point-in-time absolute net-profit rank may proxy established earnings capacity, disclosure credibility, liquidity, and resilience that can be repriced over the next three sessions; this is a scale mechanism rather than growth, ROE efficiency, announcement timing, or minute-path behavior.
selected_candidate.formula: Attach the latest separately available finite net_profit state from disclosures effective strictly before the stock day, require net_profit>0, and compute its same-stock-day average-tie percentile rank on the exact finite identity cross-section.
selected_candidate.availability_rule: Each report becomes usable only on the first accepted local session strictly after announcement_date.
selected_candidate.same_effective_date_rule: Sort instrument, effective session, report_date, and announcement_date, then keep the last row per instrument and effective session.
selected_candidate.state_rule: Forward-fill only finite strictly positive net_profit inside each instrument after strict effective-session ordering; never backfill from a later disclosure.
selected_candidate.cross_section_rule: On each stock day compute pandas-compatible average-tie percentile rank on the exact finite positive net-profit identity cross-section.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing without an already-effective finite strictly positive net-profit state and a finite cross-sectional rank. Never impute, clip, winsorize, rescale, substitute, backfill, or choose a favorable report.
